subject: Re: GDPR DPA / SCC selection - Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-18T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Following our discovery call - DPA & SCC next steps

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum on the GDPR / DPA items you asked about:  

Key takeaways from our call:
- Acme will act as the Controller for this integration; Redwood will be the Processor.
- Acme requested our DPA and confirmation on which SCC module we sign for Controller->Processor transfers.
- You also asked for our current SOC 2 status and to initiate the vendor security questionnaire.

What I attached:  
- Redwood_DPA_draft_v2.pdf — redlineable DPA draft with standard C2P language.
- SCC-module-comparison.xlsx — short overview of Controller-Processor (C2P) vs Processor-Processor modules and recommended clauses.

Answers to your questions:  
- SOC 2: Redwood is currently completing a SOC 2 Type II assessment; report expected Q1 2027. We can share the interim Type I evidence and the security controls matrix now if helpful.
- SCCs/DPA: For a standard customer relationship where Acme is Controller and Redwood is Processor, we typically execute the Controller-to-Processor SCC annex (C2P). The attached spreadsheet highlights the mapping and where we propose a few minor Acme-specific tweaks if needed.
- Vendor questionnaire: I’ve attached the questionnaire you sent. If you prefer, we can (a) fill an initial pass and send back, or (b) schedule a 30-min call between our security lead (Neha) and your security team to walk through controls.

Proposed next steps:  
1) Please confirm Controller vs Processor alignment (I believe you confirmed on call; repeating here for legal).
2) Legal review: I’ll loop in Rishi to handle DPA redlines. Target for initial redline back: 3 business days (by 2026-11-23).
3) Questionnaire: let us know whether you’d like a written response or a live walkthrough.
4) If SCC module adjustments are required, we can surface the proposed language in a short addendum.

I’m copying Rishi and Neha for legal/security assistance. Happy to set a quick follow-up (legal + security) if that’s easiest.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_draft_v2.pdf; SCC-module-comparison.xlsx; Acme_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire.xlsx

Thanks Marissa — this is super helpful. Quick answers/notes:  

- Confirming Acme will be the Controller and Redwood will be the Processor for customer data flows.
- We prefer the Controller-to-Processor SCC module (C2P) as the starting point. I looked at the SCC-module-comparison and it seems aligned; our legal team may request a couple of clarifications around subprocessors and data localization.
- SOC 2 timeline is fine; we’ll need at least the control matrix and any interim evidence you can share while the Type II is in progress.
- We’d like you to fill the attached vendor security questionnaire (Acme_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire.xlsx) and return an initial pass. If anything is unclear, we’ll set a follow-up call with our security team.

Thanks — Sarah

Hi Sarah — thanks for confirming. A few clarifications from legal/security:  

1) Controller/Processor: noted and we’ll ensure the DPA reflects C2P responsibilities.
2) SCC module: we are aligned on C2P. The attached SCC-module-comparison.xlsx highlights the clauses we expect to propose; most customers accept the standard language with small tailoring around subprocessors and audit access.
3) SOC 2: we’ll attach the security controls matrix and our Type I evidence in a follow-up email (Neha will send). Expected Type II final report: Q1 2027.
4) Vendor questionnaire: we’ll complete the Acme_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire.xlsx and aim to return an initial pass by 2026-11-23. If your team prefers, Neha can run a 30-min walkthrough on 2026-11-24.

Proposed legal timeline:
- 2026-11-20: Redwood to send initial DPA redlines back to Acme (we’ll use the attached Redwood_DPA_draft_v2.pdf as the starting point).
- 2026-11-23: Redwood to return initial completed vendor questionnaire and controls matrix.
- 2026-11-25: Legal sync (unless Acme wants earlier).

If that works, Marissa — can you trigger the DocuSign link for the DPA once redlines are agreed?

Thanks,
